svg.title: Sparviero fleet carrier recognition drawing
svg.desc: Original WNT1922 Sparviero fleet carrier recognition illustration. Port profile and deck plan share one hull length and equipment stations. Dimensions and unspecified layout are illustration choices. Fitted catalog main battery: 8 barrels. Internal submarine tubes are not depicted as exposed deck mounts.
